_comment: Customer #1 (the project owner) routine schedules -- the SOURCE OF TRUTH for when scheduled agents/jobs fire, per v5.0 Phase D + routines.schema.json. Agents reference this file (routine <name>) instead of hardcoding a cron in their body. Replace-semantics (A2): a customer's routines.json wholesale replaces the factory defaults.
_schedule_format_contract: Each `schedule` MUST be a valid standard 5-field cron (min hour dom mon dow), OR the literal 'stop-hook' for an event-triggered routine. NOTE: this format is NOT yet machine-validated -- routines.schema.json types schedule as a plain string and the hand-rolled PS validator has no regex/pattern support. A syntactically-valid-but-semantically-broken schedule would currently pass validation and (once a scheduler consumes this file -- not wired yet, 'Week 4') silently never fire. All schedules below are hand-verified valid. Recommended hardening surfaced to the project owner: docs/v5.0/phase-d-review-findings.md F3 (hostile-architect HIGH -- add a cron pattern to the schema + pattern support to the validator).
